definition: An unplanned interruption to a managed service or a reduction in its quality.
rationale: Use this noun for an unplanned service interruption or reduction in service quality that requires incident handling. Keep it separate from a problem (the cause), an event or alert (an observation or signal), and a security incident. Do not classify every event or log line as an incident.

allowed.text: The incident reduced payment-service response quality for new orders.
allowed.rationale: Names the service impact and the affected operation.

not_allowed.text: Every log line is an incident.
not_allowed.rationale: Conflates an observation with a service-impacting incident.

criteria: Verify that the noun identifies an unplanned interruption or quality reduction affecting a managed service.
Keep the noun distinct from a problem cause, an event, an alert, and a security-specific incident.
Confirm that the inspected ITIL practice page supports the problem/incident relationship while recognizing that it is not a complete incident glossary definition.
